themes: Indonesia's accelerating digital economy—e-commerce, fintech, and SaaS adoption—is structurally lifting local tech earnings, independent of US rate cycles.

Rotate into ASGR and NINE for mid-cap beta, but trim KREN and SLIS on overextension. Raise cash if IDX tech breadth fails to hold above 50% advancing names next week.

sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian financials now: the +1.62% ID outperformance vs US flat confirms local catalysts (rate-cut expectations, loan growth) are driving re-rating. Focus on high-beta movers NICK, LIFE, and PEGE for momentum, but lock gains on TIFA and VICO—their spikes look stretched. Add ASMI and GSMF as laggard value plays with room to catch up. Trim IMJS into strength.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's mandatory biodiesel B40/B50 blending is structurally raising demand for palm-oil-based energy, directly lifting TOBA and VKTR's feedstock-linked margins.
US tariff clarity on solar inverters and storage is a durable tailwind for SEDG and domestic peers, as Indonesia positions as a low-cost manufacturing hub for export.
Geothermal and waste-to-energy mandates under the RUPTL 2025-2034 plan create multi-year revenue visibility for CDIA and BRPT, independent of global commodity cycles.
sectors.ai: Buy the Indonesia renewables complex on this alert: TOBA, VKTR, and BRPT lead with domestic policy tailwinds and tariff-driven US peers (SEDG) confirming global demand. Rotate into TPIA for chemical-to-energy optionality. Exit POWR on profit-taking risk; hold CDIA for geothermal upside. Expect 8-12% near-term upside on follow-through volume.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Structural shift toward premiumization and halal-certified product lines is separating winners (POLU, ZONE) from commoditized players, sustaining margin expansion into H2.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum names (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) as domestic consumption re-rates on BI's dovish pivot and Lebaran restocking; fade broad sector beta, favor issuers with proven volume growth and margin resilience. Trim laggards with weak earnings visibility ahead of April CPI.
